title: From Ethical Declarations to Provable Independence: An Ontology-Driven Optimal-Transport Framework for Certifiably Fair AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Addressed by mapping gender and its proxies (e.g., given names, educational backgrounds) into an ontology-guided bias sigma-algebra, then applying optimal transport theory to construct representations statistically independent of this algebra.

Evaluated by using OWL 2-QL ontological axioms to systematically identify hidden proxies, such as ZIP codes historically linked to segregation or attendance at Historically Black Colleges, and enforcing mathematical independence from these proxies.

Captured by encoding proxy variables such as residential area (ZIP codes) and median income thresholds into a formal ontology, generating a bias sigma-algebra that is subsequently neutralized using optimal transport.
